desc: Derive the consistency check: ensure each source letter in `S` maps to at most one target letter in `T`.
Build the functional directed graph for distinct non-identity mappings and count its edges.
Determine that each nontrivial directed cycle requires one extra temporary-letter operation.
Determine that a temporary letter exists exactly when at least one letter is absent from `T`.
Implement the `O(N + 26)` Python stdin/stdout solution, including cycle detection and all impossibility cases.
